title: Text: DET Steve Liddle ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Was thinking about you enough the past week. How’s it going?

Going well Buddy.  Lloyd and the rest of the Coaching staff FaceTimed me last week for a few laughs.  Looks like they are getting the troops ready for battle. Stay safe Partner. Appreciate you checking in with us.
